diagnostics.message: The SQS event source mapping can become enabled before the scale-up Lambda execution role has its inline policy granting access to the build queue. This can cause mapping creation or initial polling to fail; order the mapping after the role policy is installed.

The webhook app updater registers the API endpoint before the API Gateway default stage is guaranteed to exist. The endpoint can be configured at GitHub while the stage is not yet serving requests; wait for the stage before running the local-exec updater.

The webhook app updater can register the callback before the API Gateway route and its integration are created. That can cause GitHub's initial or early webhook deliveries to reach an API with no matching route; make registration wait for the route.
The GitHub webhook callback can be registered before API Gateway's Lambda invoke permission is installed. An early delivery may be rejected by Lambda; order the updater after this permission.

The EventBridge target is attached to an enabled scheduled rule independently of the Lambda permission. A scheduled invocation could occur before permission creation; make the target wait for the permission.
The scheduled scale-down EventBridge target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists, allowing an early event to fail. Order the target after the permission.
The pool's scheduled EventBridge target can be installed before its Lambda invoke permission, so an early scheduled invocation may be rejected. Make the target depend on the permission.
